verdict.rationale: Make documents a dedicated 'AI Agents' app for agentic automation and API endpoints to create/update/run AI Agents (open beta), confirming agent/LLM steps can be added to workflows. However, the evidence pack lacks detail on model selection options or explicit tool-use/function-calling configuration within these steps. Missing for 10: documentation of model choice settings, tool-use/function-calling configuration details, and independent hands-on confirmation.
